example.title: Sand Creek tributary bridge, county road 230
example.place: northwest of La Crosse, Rush County, KS
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Sand Creek tributary bridge, county road 230 (Rush County, Kansas))

brief: Two-span segmental stone arch culvert on a county road: long, low arches of squared limestone with smooth voussoirs, walls of even buff courses and a solid parapet about three courses high capped with a smooth coping, stepping down at the ends; timber guardrail posts on one side. Short-grass prairie, sandy channel.

traits.railing_detail: low solid stone parapet with coping
